lines: Mind the sunny corner. What do you need?
Step clear of the sunny corner. What do you need?
Mind the sunny corner. I'm listening.
Hello. Did you need me, or did we both stop here by accident?
Morning. Or afternoon. The work makes the hours blur if I let it.
You caught me between odd jobs. It is a comfortable place.
Hello. Please begin with the part that makes sense.
I have a moment. I may have misplaced several others.
Come in. The doorway has finished being mysterious for now.
Hi. I was listening to the bell not ring.
There you are. I thought those footsteps belonged to someone else.
Hello there. I was deciding whether that bucket looked lonely.
You look like you brought a question. Set it down gently.
Hello there. Ignore the pebble. It knows what it did.
I was about to become busy, so your timing is excellent.
Need something? I am unusually available and usually unusual.
Welcome. Stand wherever the floor seems most confident.
I recognize you. That saved us both an introduction.
Hello. I hope this is easier than the last thing someone asked me.
You found me. I was not hiding, but it still counts.
